blockers.checkpoint_loses_reference_topology: Do not treat native checkpoint bytes/hash equality as complete heap/alias equivalence.
blockers.facade_lock_and_global_registry: Define exclusive serial access and an explicit synchronization-resource inventory; do not deepcopy, omit or pretend to restore a lock.
blockers.joint_commit_and_rollback_unverified: No real joined owner/candidate/receipt transaction has been tested.
blockers.producer_oracle_missing_m1_types: Add exact source-bound support for M1, nested runtime, RNG, counters and observed containers before any live clone. Unknown fields remain rejection.

facts.interpretation: Real observe snapshots and restores its existing components; it does not include v0.5 or an adapter.
Outcome faults can occur after predictive revision; existing rollback is component reconstruction.
Internal M1 rollback can replace object graphs, so retained references need an explicit policy.
The real facade owns a synchronization handle, not an ordinary copied state field.
Lock ownership reaches a module-global weak registry outside a producer-only graph.
The nested reference runtime owns RNG and retained state omitted by a v0.5-only class registry.
Encoding uses a recursion stack and canonicalized mappings, not an alias-preserving reference-node table.
Mapping reconstruction alone is not proof of original concrete mapping type, order or aliases.
The existing producer oracle correctly fails closed on unsupported types/fields; it must not be weakened by omission.
The default real M1 uses the source-bound predictive wrapper and scope pilot.
The predictive wrapper owns the real v0.3.2 facade rather than an unspecified reference object.
Predictive checkpoint save reaches the direct reference-brain tree serializer.
Predictive checkpoint load reconstructs and requires the v0.3.2 facade.

limitations: Hashes, AST ranges and literal source tokens are inspected. The commit ID is declared provenance; this auditor does not query Git. This is not a whole-program proof, runtime graph inventory, checkpoint certificate or G0 pass.
